# Equilibrium Daily

> One short note a day, each stating and proving one result in economics or finance. Notes are drafted by AI and reviewed before publication. Each note states one result, proves it in a PDF, and lists its sources. Everything is free to read, cite and reuse.

Notes are drafted by an AI model, checked, and reviewed by a person before publication. Errors are reported on X (https://x.com/equilibriumdail). The full text of every note, in Markdown with LaTeX, is at https://equilibriumdaily.github.io/llms-full.txt; each note is also available as Markdown at /notes/<id>.md.

## About

- [About](https://equilibriumdaily.github.io/about.html): how notes are produced and corrected
- [Why](https://equilibriumdaily.github.io/why.html): evidence on gatekeeping in academic publishing
- [Archive](https://equilibriumdaily.github.io/archive.html): all notes, newest first
- [Atom feed](https://equilibriumdaily.github.io/feed.xml)
